The '''Desilijic Complex''', also called '''Jabba's town house''' or his '''Tatooine townhome''', was a safe house used by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] located in the spaceport city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] near [[DeMaal's Docking Bay]] and the [[Jango Fett Arena]]. It was built over a large system of underground tunnels and grottos.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The complex was frequented by both [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|gardullathehutt|Gardulla the Hutt}}</ref> and her accountant, [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]].

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gave audience to [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] there when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] came looking for safe passage into the desert. Over [[0 BBY/Legends|three decades later]], the thieves [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]] and [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] broke into the building and stole many of the Hutt's valuable possessions. They also received a [[datadot]] from a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] prisoner — a highly ranked agent named [[Barid Mesoriaam]] — there, and delivered it to a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] later. They were eventually confronted by a series of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards but escaped with a very small amount of their original loot.

After the death of Jabba, [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] burgled the town house, stealing several valuable artifacts. Among them were the [[Minstrel]] and the [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddess]], a statue Jabba once stole from the people of [[Godo]].<ref name="Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref>
